notes: The ATO says to use total expenses to turnover as the key range instead where cost of sales is only a small amount. It does not put a figure on small, so both ranges are reported and that judgement is yours.

These buckets were omitted, not evidenced as zero, so their ratios are not_supplied: other_income, cost_of_sales_labour, salary_wages, contractor_commission, associated_persons, rent, motor_vehicle, other_expense.

other_business_income was omitted. The ATO rule divides by sales, or by total business income once other income exceeds sales, so every ratio is not_supplied until that figure is established. Benchmark interest rate read for 2025-26 (s 109N(2)): 0.0837.

The operator must also establish whether s 9A applies: from 2024-25 it takes eligible lump sums in arrears out of taxable income when they are at least 10% of normal taxable income and its accrual-year tests are met. Applies the 2% rate and the low-income reduction: no levy at or below the threshold amount, and up to the phase-in limit no more than 10% of the excess over it. Excludes the family income reduction, SAPTO thresholds, exemptions, the Medicare levy surcharge, trustees and part-year residence.
